list.title: Boiler and Steam Piping System Installation Works
list.description: Provide complete boiler plant and steam piping installation, including steam generation connections, main steam lines, branch distribution lines, condensate recovery lines, drain piping, safety valves, control valves, traps, supports, insulation, identification, and all associated accessories.

list.title: Compressed Air, Vacuum and Gas Network Installation Works
list.description: Provide complete installation of compressed air, vacuum, nitrogen, and oxygen piping networks, including material supply, fabrication, installation, testing, and inspection in accordance with project requirements.

list.title: Fire Protection Piping System Works
list.description: Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Complete Firefighting Piping System. Provide all labor, materials, equipment, tools, and accessories necessary for the complete installation of the firefighting piping system, including pipes, fittings, flanges, couplings, valves, supports, hangers, anchors, sleeves, identification labels, sprinkler branch connections, and equipment connections. Execute all works in accordance with the approved shop drawings, project specifications, and applicable codes and standards. The scope includes pipe cutting, threading, welding, grooving, painting/coating where specified, pressure testing, flushing, cleaning, testing, commissioning, and obtaining the Engineer's approval, ensuring the system is complete, fully operational, and ready for service.

list.title: HVAC Chilled Water Network Installation Works
list.description: Chilled water system: Installation of chilled water piping, valves, supports, insulation, equipment connections, pressure testing, flushing, and commissioning in accordance with approved drawings and project specifications.

list.title: Supply, Installation and Finishing of Wall Sandwich Panel System
list.description: Supply and install wall sandwich panels, including framing, insulation, joint sealing, accessories, and finishing works as per approved drawings and specifications.
